top_signals.title: Firmus Misfire Casts Shadow on Data Center IPOs in the Pipeline
top_signals.summary: The expected postponement of Nvidia Corp.-backed data center company Firmus Grid Ltd.’s Australian IPO is an ominous sign for other proposed listings, coming after a string of disappointing debuts for artificial intelligence infrastructure firms.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Global Banks Bolster Japan Debt Teams as Bond Issuance Booms
top_signals.summary: Global financial institutions are beefing up their debt capital market teams in Japan, hiring bankers and relocating staff, to capture a boom in fundraising driven by mergers, acquisitions, and artificial intelligence capital.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
